name: openpixo/horde-topdown
title: Horde top-down
description: Chunky, color-coded units on a calm ground so players, swarms and pickups stay readable on crowded screens.

description_i18n.en: Chunky, color-coded units on a calm ground so players, swarms and pickups stay readable on crowded screens.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 敦实且按颜色区分的单位配合低对比地面，让玩家、怪群和拾取物在满屏混战中依然一眼可辨。

examples.title: Swarm enemy family
examples.prompt: Generate five matching top-down swarm enemies using the horde-topdown art style: small bat, slime blob, skeleton grunt, armored beetle and a larger elite brute. Keep them cool-toned and desaturated, each with a thick outline and a soft drop shadow, so they never compete with the player color.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 horde-topdown 美术风格生成五个配套的俯视角怪群敌人：小蝙蝠、史莱姆、骷髅小兵、甲壳虫和体型更大的精英蛮兵。统一使用冷色、低饱和配色，粗描边加柔和投影，避免与玩家颜色冲突。

examples.title: Pickups and projectiles
examples.prompt: Create a matching set of pickups and projectiles using the horde-topdown art style: experience gem, gold coin, healing heart, magnet, spinning blade and a glowing orb. Make every item readable at 24 pixels with bright warm or green accents.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 horde-topdown 美术风格制作一套配套的拾取物和弹道：经验宝石、金币、回血爱心、磁铁、旋转飞刃和发光法球。所有物件在 24 像素下清晰可辨，使用明亮的暖色或绿色点缀。

style.prompt: High-readability top-down action game art built for crowded screens: chunky simplified units with a thick dark outline and a bold silhouette per role. Color-code by role: the player warm and bright, enemies cool and desaturated, pickups glowing gold or green. Every unit sits on a small soft drop shadow over a muted low-contrast ground with sparse decoration, so units, projectiles and pickups pop instantly. Overhead three-quarter view; effects are bright but translucent and never hide the player.
style.negativePrompt: busy high-contrast ground texture, tiny details, thin outlines, realistic proportions, enemies sharing the player color, photorealism, explicit gore, dark muddy screen, perspective camera, text, damage numbers, interface, watermark

constraints.outline: Thick dark outline on every unit and pickup; none on ground tiles.
